description: List all deprecated Exeris SDK annotations and attributes across the authoring contract, including replacement guidance, since version, and forRemoval status. Supports filtering by package or forRemoval only.

forRemovalOnly.description: If true, only returns items marked for removal (forRemoval: true). Defaults to false.

package.description: Optional package filter (e.g. 'system', 'security', 'capability', or full package name).

name: sdk-list_deprecations
